Session date: 6:03 pm on 5 September, 2022
[D20:10] Joanna: Yeah, since I'm lactose intolerant I'm trying out dairy-free options like coconut or almond milk instead. It's been a fun challenge seeing how to make yummy treats that suit everyone's diets. I even made these dairy-free chocolate coconut cupcakes with raspberry frosting.
[D20:11] Nate: Woah, those look great, Joanna! It's cool that you make desserts that work for everyone's diets. Do you have any more yummy recipes hiding in there?
[D20:12] Joanna: Yep! I've been making all sorts of desserts that work for everyone's diets - cookies, pies, cakes - everything! I'll share more recipes with you soon.
[D20:13] Nate: Can't wait to try them. Can I join you sometime? I think baking and cooking really brings us together!
[...]
Session date: 1:43 pm on 14 September, 2022
[D21:4] Nate: Hey Joanna, I'm no writer like you, but something pretty awesome happened. Last Monday I got to teach people vegan ice cream recipes on my own cooking show! It was a bit nerve-wracking to put myself out there, but it was a blast. Plus, I picked up a few new recipes!
[D21:5] Joanna: Way to go, Nate! Congrats on the cooking show, I'll definitely be tuning in! What's your favorite dish from the show?
[D21:6] Nate: Coconut milk ice cream is at the top of my list. It's so smooth and creamy with a tropical coconut twist. Plus, it's dairy-free for people who can't have lactose or who want vegan options. Here's a snap of the ice cream I made.
[...]
[D21:8] Nate: Yeah sure! Would love to share it. Let's spread the joy of dairy-free options! Let me know when you make it!
[D21:9] Joanna: Cool, Nate! Gonna give it a go. Dairy-free is a must for me, especially for desserts. Last Friday, I made a deeeelish dessert with almond milk - it was good! Got any favs when it comes to dairy-free desserts?
[D21:10] Nate: Coconut milk ice cream is one of my favorites as you might be able to tell, but I also love a dairy-free chocolate mousse. It's super creamy and tastes like the real thing. What's been your favorite dairy-free sweet treat so far?
[D21:11] Joanna: Hey Nate, my favorite dairy-free treat is this amazing chocolate raspberry tart. It has an almond flour crust, chocolate ganache, and fresh raspberries - it's delicious!
[D21:12] Nate: That looks amazing, Joanna! I need to try baking that. What other treats do you like making?

Session date: 7:31 pm on 21 January, 2022

[D1:13] Nate: I love action and sci-fi movies, the effects are so cool! What about you, what's your favorite genre?
[D1:14] Joanna: I'm all about dramas and romcoms. I love getting immersed in the feelings and plots.

Session date: 9:27 am on 7 February, 2022
[D3:1] Joanna: Hey Nate, long time no see! The screenplay I sent in to the film festival has been on my mind all day everyday. I keep bouncing between crazy emotions like relief, excitement and worry! Fingers crossed a producer or director falls in love with it and it ends up on the big screen - that would be awesome!
[D3:2] Nate: Hey Joanna! It is a big deal! I'm sure its been a wild ride. Sending some positive vibes and hoping someone likes it enough to get it on the big screen - that would be awesome!
[D3:3] Joanna: Thanks Nate, your support really means a lot. I put a lot of effort into it and I'm crossing my fingers. What about you? Anything new and exciting happening in your life?
[D3:4] Nate: Thanks, Joanna. Not much has changed for me, but I just discovered that I can make coconut milk icecream and gave it a try. It was actually pretty good, so I'm proud of myself.
[D3:5] Joanna: Looks delish! Glad you tried something new and it went well. What did you think of it?
[D3:6] Nate: Super good! It was rich and creamy - might be my new favorite snack!
[D3:7] Joanna: Great! I love when you try something new and it actually works out. Will you give it another go?
[D3:8] Nate: Yep, it could be fun! I'm looking forward to trying out different flavors and toppings.
[D3:9] Joanna: Yum! Sounds great. Got any favorite flavors for dairy-free desserts?

Session date: 8:16 pm on 25 October, 2022
[D25:19] Nate: They eat a combination of vegetables, fruits, and insects. They have a varied diet.
[D25:20] Joanna: Wow, that's fascinating! It's interesting how they have such a varied diet, including insects. Do you have a favorite among their food choices?
[D25:21] Nate: I love seeing them eat fruit - they get so hyped and it's so cute!
[D25:22] Joanna: Wow, that's so cute! They look like they really enjoy fruit.
[D25:23] Nate: Yeah, it's adorable! Watching them enjoy their favorite snacks is so fun. I also like holding them.
[D25:24] Joanna: Do they have different personalities, like the way dogs and cats do?
[...]
Session date: 3:56 pm on 4 November, 2022
[D26:5] Joanna: Thanks Nate! Your support and encouragement mean a lot. Writing isn't always easy but moments like these make me appreciate it. I'm so thankful for all the opportunities. Last week, I found these old notebooks with my early writings - it was cool to see how far I've come.
[D26:6] Nate: That's cool! You must love seeing how you've grown as an artist. Is there a favorite piece from your early writings that stands out to you?
[D26:7] Joanna: Yup, I still remember this story from when I was 10. It was about a brave little turtle who was scared but explored the world anyway. Maybe even back then, I was inspired by stories about finding courage and taking risks. It's still a part of my writing today.
[...]
Session date: 8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022
[D27:8] Joanna: Thanks Nate! Writing has always been a passion of mine. I got the idea for this script from a dream. How have your turtles been? I haven't seen pictures of them in a while!
[D27:9] Nate: Great actually! These little guys sure bring joy to my life! Watching them is so calming and fascinating. I've really grown fond of them. So, what about you, Joanna? What brings you happiness?
[D27:10] Joanna: Creating stories and watching them come alive gives me happiness and fulfillment. Writing has been such a blessing for me.

Session date: 6:12 pm on 14 August, 2022
[D18:7] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Really appreciate your kind words. It's knowing that my writing can make a difference that keeps me going, even on tough days. So glad to have this outlet to share my stories and hopefully have an impact. How about you? Anything new since we last talked?
[D18:8] Nate: Thanks, Joanna! Your words mean a lot. Since we last spoke, I started teaching people how to make this. Sharing my love for dairy-free desserts has been fun and rewarding.
[D18:9] Joanna: Yum, Nate! I love it when you make coconut milk icecream, it's so good!
[D18:10] Nate: I've been really into making this lately - it's creamy, rich, dairy-free and a new recipe! Wanna try it? I can share the recipe with you if you'd like!
[D18:11] Joanna: I'd love to try it! Thanks for sharing your love for dairy-free desserts. I really appreciate it!
[D18:12] Nate: No problem, Joanna! Always happy to share them with you. Sending you the recipe now!

Session date: 10:57 am on 22 August, 2022
[D19:8] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! It feels great knowing that people like my writing. I celebrated by making this delicious treat - yum! Any plans for the weekend?
[D19:9] Nate: I'm taking some time off this weekend to chill with my pets. Anything cool happening with you?
[D19:10] Joanna: I'm relaxing and recharging this weekend with a long walk and some reading. It's a good break.
[D19:11] Nate: Looks like we both need a break. I'm glad your able to find a way to recharge! It's so incredibly important to take time off!
[D19:12] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! I've learned that taking breaks and looking after myself are important for my inspiration and mental health. It's all about finding balance.
[D19:13] Nate: Yeah, balance is key! It's so cool how taking care of ourselves helps us be more creative and happier. I'm always looking for something new to read. Got any book recommendations? I've got a lot of books to choose from.
